selection: Six source cases fixed without running either v2 or the proposed v3 detector. Four source-positive cup-with-handle cases and two source-positive but default/book-depth-out-of-scope whole bases. These are case coverage and exclusion checks, not a random-sample estimate of precision.
method: Positive checks require exact kind plus left-rim date window plus detection window. Depth-exclusion negatives reject either Cup kind for that whole base. No future bars beyond as_of. Price data downloaded after source labels and windows were fixed. Windows follow source text and visual weekly-chart date resolution.
